turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need a new helmet and I've got it down to a few options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Don't comment yet, let me describe all of them first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One is a basic commuter helmet, cheap and comfy, with a built in rear light.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a lightweight road helmet with loads of vents, but no light and quite pricey.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a folding helmet that collapses flat to fit in my bag.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a full face mountain bike helmet my brother is giving away for free.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So those are the options. What's your take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For daily commuting, the basic helmet with a built in light is really practical. The road helmet only makes sense for long, hot rides. The folding one is great if you use bike share and carry it around.
